# bluestonepim_category_column_attribute (Resource)

Assigns a `column` attribute definition to a category (Category Level Attribute).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bluestonepim_category" "my_category" {
  name = "My category"
}

resource "bluestonepim_column_attribute_definition" "dimensions" {
  name = "Dimensions"
  columns = [
    { value = "Width" },
    { value = "Height" },
  ]
}

resource "bluestonepim_category_column_attribute" "dimensions" {
  category_id             = bluestonepim_category.my_category.id
  attribute_definition_id = bluestonepim_column_attribute_definition.dimensions.id
  propagate               = true

  values = {
    (bluestonepim_column_attribute_definition.dimensions.columns[0].id) = "10"
    (bluestonepim_column_attribute_definition.dimensions.columns[1].id) = "20"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attribute_definition_id` (String) The ID of the attribute definition.
- `category_id` (String) The ID of the category.

### Optional

- `mandatory` (Boolean) Require all products in this category to have a value for this attribute.
- `propagate` (Boolean) Propagate the attribute and its value to all subcategories and their products.
- `values` (Map of String) The value per column, keyed by the column ID of the attribute definition (see `columns` of `bluestonepim_column_attribute_definition`). Columns left out are empty.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bluestonepim_category_column_attribute.my_column_attribute <category_id>/<attribute_definition_id>
```
